title: iPhone 16 Pro Max Skeleton Case
author: layers_lab
description:
## Welcome to LayersLab

Original 3D-printable designs made with functionality, clean design, and reliable printability in mind. Happy printing!

Boost Me (for free)

Love this model? A Boost is one of the best ways to support my work. Thanks for your support!

Boost

Have an idea you'd like to see designed? Share your idea here: IDEA BOX or Send me a DM on Instagram—I’m always looking for interesting problems to solve and new ideas to create.

**Community Note:** This design is constantly evolving and improving. For the best results, please slice the model yourself or use the latest community print profile. I don't own a Bambu Lab printer, so I can't create or maintain print profiles—I rely on the community to keep them up to date.

If you use an existing print profile, please rate it and leave a comment so others know it works. If you slice the model yourself and don't see a current print profile here, please consider uploading yours for everyone to use. A community that looks out for one another is a community that thrives. Thank you for helping keep this project better for everyone!

Print at 0.1mm layer height for better fillet look.

Don't print it with TPU its not preferable.

**I’ve added a new design to a folder called “New Slim Stronger with Camera Bump”.  Slice the file and print them; it’s the latest design and is both slim and much stronger.**

\*\*The photo used in the profile model is taken by a user & is authorised by the owner for fair use\*\*
